cand.title: ACCUO / AOUCC 2027 Toronto Conference
cand.organizationName: Association of Canadian College and University Ombudspersons
cand.excerpt: Confirmed dates and venue establish the event; commercial accessibility and room demand remain to be verified.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified relationship/navigation contacts, neither a verified hotel buyer: Oluwakemi (Kemi) Oke, ACCUO President and York University Ombudsperson; and Edmun Natkunarajah, ACCUO Member-at-Large and TMU Assistant Ombudsperson & Outreach Officer. Oke provides association leadership access; Natkunarajah bridges the association and 2027 host institution. Their relevance to lodging introductions is an inference from these roles; neither source establishes conference purchasing or contract-signing authority.
findings.futureEdition: Officially confirmed upcoming edition: May 3–6, 2027, Toronto, Ontario, Canada; hosted by Toronto Metropolitan University. The event record specifies May 3 at 5:00 p.m. EDT through May 6 at 1:00 p.m. EDT. These are activity dates, not the October 30, 2026 announcement date, and fall within the requested horizon. No later 2028 edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel constraints: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a possible lodging-only or speaker/VIP group option, not the announced meeting venue. A limited block could fit the supplied 157-room inventory, but attendance, non-local share and peak rooms are unpublished, so neither a 15–109-room group nor any room-night total is an event forecast. TMU is downtown rather than Harbourfront; the hotel’s MTCC proximity does not establish convenience to this conference. Campus access/transport and rate competitiveness require validation. This is a city-campus conference, with no sourced resort requirement. Do not pitch replacement plenaries or promise catering/receptions without demand and restaurant/lounge verification. There is insufficient evidence to classify the event as too large or too small for the hotel.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Toronto Metropolitan University, 350 Victoria St, Toronto, Ontario M5B 2K3, Canada. TMU is in downtown Toronto proper, within the downtown territory, not at Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. The university is the announced host and venue, not a competing hotel. No specific campus building, meeting room or signed venue agreement is disclosed; the street address alone does not establish an exact room assignment.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented recent sequence: joint ENOHE/ACCUO virtual conference, September 21–22, 2021; ACCUO virtual Community Reconnect, February 3, 2022; joint FCO/ACCUO conference at Fairmont Empress, Victoria, October 22–24, 2024; ACCUO online conference, November 21, 2025; announced Toronto/TMU edition, May 3–6, 2027. This demonstrates mixed online and physical formats, not a verified annual destination rotation. The joint FCO event is not interchangeable with a standalone ACCUO conference. No standalone 2026 conference was located; the May 27, 2026 AGM is not treated as one.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 sourcing is unconfirmed. Official announcement: “Additional information about the conference program, accommodations, and registration will be shared in the coming weeks.” Neither the reviewed announcement nor event record names a hotel, room block, official housing bureau, agency, booking link, hotel RFP or sourcing deadline. Every 2027 hotel listed in those materials: none. This does not prove accommodation is uncontracted or sourcing is open. Historical only: the joint 2024 event explicitly offered Fairmont Empress group rates and instructed guests, “Please identify that you are with the FCO/ACCUO conference.” That hotel is not established as a 2027 incumbent.
findings.organizationStructure: ACCUO/AOUCC is a professional association for college and university ombuds professionals, with an elected executive committee providing leadership and oversight. It owns the announced association conference; TMU is identified as host/venue, not a PCO. No external PCO, DMC, housing agency or corporate event owner is identified in the reviewed 2027 materials. The discovery segment scaling_companies should not be used as the organization classification.
findings.competitiveLimitations: TMU already holds the announced meeting-venue position. No 2027 incumbent lodging hotel, exclusivity, housing-bureau restriction, sold-out block or overflow shortage is published in the reviewed official materials. The Fairmont Empress group offer belongs to the joint Victoria 2024 edition only. Inference: campus convenience may be a competitive issue for a Harbourfront hotel; no named Toronto competitor or displacement opportunity is established.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Kemi Oke and Edmun Natkunarajah for introduction to the 2027 conference accommodation/procurement lead. Use conference@accuo.ca as a previously published conference route, explicitly verified for the 2025 event rather than a confirmed 2027 sales address; info@accuo.ca is a published association membership-inquiry route for redirection. Ask whether hotels are contracted, who sources rooms, whether university residence or individual booking is planned, and for the complete hotel list, booking deadlines, non-local attendance, peak rooms, stay pattern and rate parameters. If a real gap remains, offer a modest lodging proposal subject to inventory and campus-access review; do not send an unsolicited full-event buyout or meeting-venue replacement pitch.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of November 15, 2026, the 2027 edition is confirmed but lodging accessibility is unknown. The event page says “Tickets are not on sale”; this is attendee-registration status, not evidence of hotel procurement availability. Published plans to release accommodation information justify asking now who handles housing, not representing an open RFP or assured block opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional strategy, not confirmed demand: if 2027 lodging is already allocated, ask about supplemental speaker/delegate rooms or cancellations only after permission and actual unmet demand are established. Maintain an association relationship for a future Toronto cycle, but do not assign dates, Toronto location or room demand to 2028 or later; no such edition was identified. Mixed virtual/in-person history and the joint 2024 hotel event do not prove an annual Toronto capture cycle.
